title: Lifetime energy accumulators publish state_class measurement with device_class energy
claim: The three energy accumulators (space_heating_energy, dhw_energy, total_energy) inherit _AccumulatingSensor._attr_state_class = MEASUREMENT, an impossible pair for device_class ENERGY, so Home Assistant warns on every state write and the Energy dashboard cannot offer them.
mechanism: sensor.py _AccumulatingSensor sets _attr_state_class = SensorStateClass.MEASUREMENT while its docstring and tests/entities.py ('<name> is TOTAL_INCREASING') state TOTAL_INCREASING; SpaceEnergySensor, DHWEnergySensor and TotalEnergySensor do not override it (the cost subclass overrides to TOTAL).

evidence.unit: violating (cell, cycle, entity) triples, class state_class_impossible
evidence.contention_note: shared box, other seats running; count is contention-immune

metric_definition: Count of (cell, cycle, sensor) triples whose state_class is not in DEVICE_CLASS_STATE_CLASSES[device_class], over 6 cells x 2 cycles x every built entity.
phenomenon_property: Every sensor's declared state_class is admissible for its device_class (HA DEVICE_CLASS_STATE_CLASSES); energy meters are TOTAL or TOTAL_INCREASING.
reproduction_steps: read RESULT state_class_impossible=36 and the VIOLATION lines
proposed_fix_scope: Set _AccumulatingSensor._attr_state_class to SensorStateClass.TOTAL_INCREASING (cost subclass keeps TOTAL); tests/entities.py's existing TOTAL_INCREASING check then holds. Overlaps D8-s1's M2 cell (state_class vs device_class) -- judge to dedupe.
